WindowConfig

class WindowConfig[source]

Bases: object

Mixin that configures title, icon, size and position of a window.

Used together with a Qt window class (e.g. class MainView( QMainWindow, Ui_MainView, WindowConfig)): the size can be changed by a percentage relative to the parent window or the screen, and the window is centered and gets a fixed size.

Attributes:
STAY_SIZEint, class attribute

Keep the base size (0).

INCREMENT_SIZE_PERCENTint, class attribute

Increase the base size by a percentage (1).

DECREMENT_SIZE_PERCENTint, class attribute

Decrease the base size by a percentage (2).

Methods

setup_window(title=None, icon=None, status=STAY_SIZE, …)

Configure title, icon, size and position.

get_base_size(parent)

Return the base size from the parent window or the screen.

adjust_size(base, percent, status)

Adjust a size by a percentage according to status.

center_window(parent=None, width=None, height=None)

Center the window on the parent window or the screen.

setup_window

Configure title, icon, size and position of the window.
setup_window(title=None, icon=None, status=0, width=0.0, height=0.0, parent=None)[source]

Configure title, icon, size and position of the window.

Parameters:
titlestr | None, optional

Window title; None keeps the current one. Default is None.

iconstr | QIcon | None, optional

Icon file path (or icon); None keeps the current one. Default is None.

statusint, optional

STAY_SIZE, INCREMENT_SIZE_PERCENT or DECREMENT_SIZE_PERCENT. Default is STAY_SIZE.

widthfloat, optional

Width change in percent (e.g. 10 means 10%). Default is 0.

heightfloat, optional

Height change in percent. Default is 0.

parentQWidget | None, optional

Reference window for size and centering; None uses the screen. Default is None.

Notes

The base size comes from get_base_size, each dimension is changed by adjust_size, the window is centered with center_window and its size is then fixed (it cannot be resized).

get_base_size(parent=None)[source]

Return the base size from the parent window or the screen.

Parameters:
parentQWidget | None, optional

Reference window. Default is None.

Returns:
tuple[int, int]

The parent’s width and height, or half the width and height of the primary screen when there is no parent (or it has no geometry).

adjust_size(base, percent, status)[source]

Adjust a size by a percentage according to status.

Parameters:
basefloat

Base size (width or height) in pixels.

percentfloat

Percentage to add or remove (e.g. 10 for 10%).

statusint

STAY_SIZE, INCREMENT_SIZE_PERCENT or DECREMENT_SIZE_PERCENT.

Returns:
float

The adjusted size; base unchanged when percent is 0 or negative or status is STAY_SIZE (or unknown).

Examples

>>> cfg = WindowConfig()
>>> cfg.adjust_size(800, 10, cfg.DECREMENT_SIZE_PERCENT)
720.0
>>> cfg.adjust_size(800, 25, cfg.INCREMENT_SIZE_PERCENT)
1000.0
>>> cfg.adjust_size(800, 10, cfg.STAY_SIZE)
800
center_window(parent=None, width=None, height=None)[source]

Center the window on the parent window or the screen.

Parameters:
parentQWidget | None, optional

Reference window; None (or no geometry) uses the primary screen. Default is None.

widthfloat | None, optional

Window width in pixels; None uses the current width. Default is None.

heightfloat | None, optional

Window height in pixels; None uses the current height. Default is None.

Notes

The position and size are set with setGeometry. On the screen, the position is computed from the screen size only, so the screen is assumed to start at (0, 0).
